effects.name: Fusion Core
effects.description: A fusion cell spliced into the weapon's feed, retuning itself to whatever the target can't stand.

effects.name: Overclocked
effects.description: Every safety in the weapon has been bridged. It fires twice. It also smokes.

effects.name: Smoking
effects.description: The weapon is too hot to hold properly.

newAbility.name: Fusion Core
newAbility.description: Splice a fusion cell into whatever you're holding. For a few turns every weapon attack carries an extra charge of the one element its target resists least.

newAbility.name: War Rig
newAbility.description: Bridge every safety on the weapon. Your next three weapon attacks fire a second charge at half strength. Each one has a chance to cook the mods and leave you fighting with a smoking gun.
